40020763.author: पदार्थः
40020763.content: ततः then, जित्वा having conquered, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, यमम् Yama, त्रिदशपुङ्गवम् the chief among the gods, रावणः Ravana, तु and, रणश्लाघी one who boasts of his prowess in battle, स्वसहायान् his own companions, ददर्श saw, ह indeed.

40020763.author: Translation
40020763.content: Then, having conquered Yama, the chief among the gods, Ravana, who boasted of his prowess in battle, indeed saw his own companions.

40020764.author: पदार्थः
40020764.content: ततः then, रुधिरसिक्ताङ्गम् whose body was drenched in blood, प्रहारैः by blows, जर्जरीकृतम् shattered, रावणम् Ravana, राक्षसाः the demons, दृष्ट्वा having seen, हि indeed, अष्टवत् auspiciously, समुपागमन् approached.

40020764.author: Translation
40020764.content: Then, having seen Ravana, whose body was drenched in blood and shattered by blows, the demons indeed approached him auspiciously.

40020765.author: पदार्थः
40020765.content: जयेन by victory, वर्धयित्वा having increased (celebrated), च and, मारीचप्रमुखाः Maricha and others (chiefs), ततः then, पुष्पकम् Pushpaka (chariot), भेजिरे resorted to (boarded), सर्वे all, सान्त्विताः consoled, रावणेन by Ravana, तु indeed

40020765.author: Translation
40020765.content: After Ravana had consoled them and celebrated their victory, Maricha and the other chiefs all boarded the Pushpaka chariot.

40020766.author: पदार्थः
40020766.content: ततः then, रसातलं Rasatala (the lowest netherworld), गच्छन् going, प्रविष्टः entered, पयसाम् of waters, निधिम् the ocean (abode), दैत्योरगगणाध्युष्टम् inhabited by hosts of Daityas and Nagas (serpents), वरुणेन by Varuna, सुरक्षितम् well-protected

40020766.author: Translation
40020766.content: Then, proceeding to Rasatala, he entered the ocean, which was inhabited by hosts of Daityas and Nagas and well-protected by Varuna.

40020767.author: पदार्थः
40020767.content: सः he, तु indeed, भोगवतीम् Bhogavati (city name), गत्वा having gone, पुरीम् city, वासुकिपालिताम् protected by Vasuki, कृत्वा having made, नागान् the Nagas (serpents), वशे under control, हृष्टः delighted, ययौ went, मणिमयीम् gem-studded, पुरीम् city

40020767.author: Translation
40020767.content: Having gone to the city of Bhogavati, protected by Vasuki, and having brought the Nagas under his control, he, delighted, proceeded to the gem-studded city.

40020768.author: पदार्थः
40020768.content: निवातकवचाः Nivātakavachas, तत्र there, दैत्याः Daityas, लब्धवराः who had obtained boons, वसन् lived, राक्षसान् the Rakshasa (Ravana), तान् them (the Nivātakavachas), समागम्य having approached, युद्धाय for battle, समुपाह्वयत् challenged

40020768.author: Translation
40020768.content: There lived the Nivātakavachas, Daityas who had obtained boons, and Ravana, having approached them, challenged them to battle.

40020769.author: पदार्थः
40020769.content: ते they, तु indeed, सर्वे all, सुविक्रान्ताः very mighty (valiant), दैतेयाः Daityas, बलशालिनः powerful, नानाप्रहरणाः having various weapons, तत्र there, प्रहृष्टाः delighted (overjoyed), युद्धदुर्मदाः intoxicated with battle (fierce in battle)

40020769.author: Translation
40020769.content: All those Daityas were indeed very mighty, powerful, equipped with various weapons, and overjoyed and fierce in battle.

40020770.author: पदार्थः
40020770.content: शूलैः with spears, त्रिशूलैः with tridents, कुलिशैः with thunderbolts, पट्टिशासिपरश्वधैः with sharp-edged spears, swords, and axes, अन्योन्यं each other, बिभिदुः pierced, क्रुद्धाः enraged, राक्षसाः the Rakshasas, दानवाः the Danavas, तथा and.

40020770.author: Translation
40020770.content: The enraged Rakshasas and Danavas fiercely pierced each other with spears, tridents, thunderbolts, sharp-edged spears, swords, and axes.

40020771.author: पदार्थः
40020771.content: तेषां of them, तु indeed, युध्यमानानां who were fighting, साग्रः more than, संवत्सरः a year, गतः passed, न not, च and, अन्यतरयोः of either of the two, तत्र there, विजयो victory, वा or, क्षयो destruction, अपि even, वा or.

40020771.author: Translation
40020771.content: As they continued to fight, more than a year passed, yet neither side achieved victory nor suffered complete destruction.

40020772.author: पदार्थः
40020772.content: ततः then, पितामहः the grandfather (Brahma), तत्र there, त्रैलोक्यगतिः the resort of the three worlds, अव्ययः the imperishable, आजगाम came, द्रुतं quickly, देवो the god, विमानवरम् on an excellent aerial car, आस्थितः seated.

40020772.author: Translation
40020772.content: Then, the imperishable god Brahma, the lord of the three worlds, quickly arrived there, seated in his magnificent aerial chariot.

40020773.author: पदार्थः
40020773.content: निवातकवचानां of the Nivatakavachas, तु indeed, निवार्य having stopped, रणकर्म the act of war, तत् that, वृद्धः the old, पितामहः grandfather (Brahma), वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke, विदितार्थवत् meaningful.

40020773.author: Translation
40020773.content: Having stopped that act of war involving the Nivatakavachas, the wise grandfather Brahma spoke meaningful words.

40020774.author: पदार्थः
40020774.content: न not, हि indeed, अयं this, रावणो Ravana, युद्धे in battle, शक्यो possible, जेतुं to conquer, सुरासुरैः by gods and asuras, न not, भवन्तः you, क्षयं to destruction, नेतुम् to lead, अपि even, सामरदानवैः by gods and Danavas.

40020774.author: Translation
40020774.content: Indeed, this Ravana cannot be conquered in battle by gods and asuras, nor can you (Nivatakavachas) be led to destruction even by gods and Danavas.

40020775.author: पदार्थः
40020775.content: राक्षसस्य of a Rakshasa, सखित्वं friendship, च and, भवद्भिः with you, सह together, रोचते is pleasing. अविभक्ताः undivided, च and, सर्वार्थाः all interests, सुहृदां of friends, न not, अत्र here, संशयः doubt.

40020775.author: Translation
40020775.content: Friendship with you Rakshasas is agreeable, and there is no doubt that all interests of friends are undivided.

40020776.author: पदार्थः
40020776.content: ततो then, अग्निसाक्षिकं with fire as witness, सख्यं friendship, कृतवान् made, तत्र there, रावणः Ravana. निवातकवचैः with the Nivātakavachas, सार्धं together with, प्रीतिमान् delighted, अभवत् became, तदा then.

40020776.author: Translation
40020776.content: Then, Ravana established a friendship with the Nivātakavachas, with fire as witness, and became delighted at that time.

40020777.author: पदार्थः
40020777.content: अर्थतः properly, तैः by them, यथान्यायं according to justice, संवत्सरम् for a year, अथ then, उषितः resided. स्वपुरात् from his own city, निर्विशेषं without distinction, च and, प्रियं affection, प्राप्तः obtained, दशाननः Dashanana.

40020777.author: Translation
40020777.content: Ravana then resided there for a year, treated properly and justly by them, receiving affection as if he were in his own city.

40020778.author: पदार्थः
40020778.content: ततः then, मायानां of magic arts, शतम् एकं one full hundred, उपधार्य having mastered, समाप्तवान् he completed (learning them), सलिलेन्द्रपुरान्वेषी seeking the city of the lord of waters, रसातलम् in the netherworld, भ्रमति स्म he wandered.

40020778.author: Translation
40020778.content: Then, having mastered a full hundred magic arts, Ravana wandered through the netherworld in search of the city of Varuna, the lord of waters.

40020779.author: पदार्थः
40020779.content: ततो then, अश्मनगरं Ashmanagara, नाम named, कालकेयैः by the Kalakeyas, अधिष्ठितम् inhabited. गत्वा having gone, तु indeed, कालकेयान् the Kalakeyas, च and, हत्वा having killed, तत्र there, बलोत्कटान् the mighty ones.

40020779.author: Translation
40020779.content: Then, having gone to the city named Ashmanagara, which was inhabited by the Kalakeyas, Ravana killed the exceedingly strong Kalakeyas there.

40020780.author: पदार्थः
40020780.content: शूर्पणख्याः of Shurpanakha, च and, भर्तारम् husband, असिना with a sword, प्राच्छिनत् cut off, तदा then. श्यालं brother-in-law, च and, बलवन्तं mighty, च and, विद्युज्जिह्वं Vidyujjihva, बलोत्कटम् exceedingly strong. जिह्वया with his tongue, संलिहन्तं licking, च and, राक्षसं Rakshasa, समरे in battle, तथा thus.

40020780.author: Translation
40020780.content: Then, Ravana cut off Shurpanakha's husband, his mighty and exceedingly strong brother-in-law named Vidyujjihva, who was a Rakshasa licking (blood/wounds) with his tongue in battle, with his sword.

40020781.author: पदार्थः
40020781.content: तम् him, विजित्य having conquered, मुहूर्तेन in a moment, जघ्ने he killed, दैत्यान् demons, चतुःशतम् four hundred,

40020781.author: Translation
40020781.content: Having conquered him, he killed four hundred demons in an instant.

40020782.author: पदार्थः
40020782.content: ततः then, पाण्डुरमेघाभम् resembling white clouds, कैलासमिव like Mount Kailasa, भास्वरम् shining, वरुणस्य of Varuna, आलयम् abode, दिव्यम् divine, अपश्यत् he saw, राक्षसाधिपः the lord of rakshasas,

40020782.author: Translation
40020782.content: Then, the lord of rakshasas saw the divine abode of Varuna, which resembled white clouds and shone like Mount Kailasa.

40020783.author: पदार्थः
40020783.content: क्षरन्तीम् flowing, च and, पयः milk, तत्र there, सुरभिम् Surabhi, गाम् cow, अवस्थिताम् standing, यस्याः from whose, पयोभिनिष्यन्दात् from the flowing of milk, क्षीरोदः Kshiroda, नाम named, सागरः ocean,

40020783.author: Translation
40020783.content: There he saw the divine cow Surabhi, standing and continuously flowing milk, from whose abundant milk flow the ocean named Kshiroda originated.

40020784.author: पदार्थः
40020784.content: ददर्श he saw, रावणः Ravana, तत्र there, गोवृषेन्द्रवरारणिम् the best source of cows, bulls, and excellent things, यस्मात् from which, चन्द्रः the moon, प्रभवति originates, शीतरश्मिः cool-rayed, निशाकरः night-maker,

40020784.author: Translation
40020784.content: There Ravana saw the ocean, the best source of cows, bulls, and excellent things, from which the cool-rayed moon, the maker of night, originated.

40020785.author: पदार्थः
40020785.content: यम् which, समाश्रित्य depending on, जीवन्ति live, फेनपाः foam-drinkers, परमर्षयः great sages, अमृतम् nectar, यत्र where, च and, उत्पन्नम् originated, स्वधा Svadhā, च and, स्वधभोजिनाम् for those who partake of Svadhā,

40020785.author: Translation
40020785.content: Great sages known as foam-drinkers subsist by depending on this ocean, and it is also where nectar and Svadhā, the offering for ancestors, originated.

40020786.author: पदार्थः
40020786.content: यां which, ब्रुवन्ति call, नरा men, लोके in the world, सुरभिं Surabhi, नाम by name, नामतः by name, प्रदक्षिणं circumambulation, तु indeed, तां her, कृत्वा having done, रावणः Ravana, परमाद्भुताम् exceedingly wonderful,

40020786.author: Translation
40020786.content: Ravana, having circumambulated the exceedingly wonderful Surabhi, whom people in the world call by that name, then proceeded.

40020787.author: पदार्थः
40020787.content: प्रविवेश entered, महाघोरं very dreadful, गुप्तं guarded, बहुविधैर्बलैः by various kinds of forces, ततो then, धाराशताकीर्णं filled with hundreds of streams, शारदाभ्रनिभं resembling an autumn cloud, तदा then, नित्यप्रहृष्टं always joyful, ददृशे he saw, वरुणस्य of Varuna, गृहोत्तमम् the excellent house,

40020787.author: Translation
40020787.content: He then entered a very dreadful place, guarded by various forces, and there he saw Varuna's excellent abode, which was filled with hundreds of streams, resembled an autumn cloud, and was always joyful.

40020788.author: पदार्थः
40020788.content: ततो then, हत्वा having killed, बलाध्यक्षान् the commanders of the army, समरे in battle, तैश्च and by them, ताडितः struck, अब्रवीच्च and he said, ततो then, योधान् to the warriors, राजा the king, शीघ्रं quickly, निवेद्यताम् let it be announced,

40020788.author: Translation
40020788.content: Then, having killed the commanders of the army in battle and being struck by them, Ravana said to the warriors, "Let the king (Varuna) be quickly informed."

40020789.author: पदार्थः
40020789.content: युद्धार्थी desirous of battle, रावणः Ravana, प्राप्तः has arrived, तस्य to him, युद्धं battle, प्रदीयताम् let it be given, वद or say, वा or, न not, भयं fear, ते to you, अस्ति is, निर्जितो conquered, अस्मि I am, इति thus, साञ्जलिः with folded hands,

40020789.author: Translation
40020789.content: "Ravana, desirous of battle, has arrived; let battle be given to him, or else, with folded hands, say 'I am conquered' if you have no fear."

40020790.author: पदार्थः
40020790.content: एतस्मिन् at this, अन्तरे moment, क्रुद्धा enraged, वरुणस्य of Varuna, महात्मनः the great-souled, पुत्राः sons, पौत्राश्च and grandsons, निष्क्रामन् came out, गौश्च and Gau, पुष्कर Pushkara, एव indeed, च and,

40020790.author: Translation
40020790.content: At this moment, the enraged sons and grandsons of the great-souled Varuna, including Gau and Pushkara, came out.

40020791.author: पदार्थः
40020791.content: ते they, तु indeed, वीर्यगुणोपेताः endowed with valorous qualities, बलैः by forces, परिवृताः surrounded, स्वकैः their own, युङ्क्त्वा having yoked, रथान् chariots, कामगमान् moving at will, उद्यद्भास्वरवर्चसः with rising brilliant splendor,

40020791.author: Translation
40020791.content: Endowed with valorous qualities and surrounded by their own forces, they yoked their chariots, which moved at will, shining with brilliant splendor.

40020792.author: पदार्थः
40020792.content: ततः then, युद्धम् battle, समभवत् occurred, दारुणम् terrible, रोमहर्षणम् hair-raising, सलिलेन्द्रस्य of the lord of waters, पुत्राणाम् of the sons, रावणस्य of Ravana, च and, धीमतः intelligent,

40020792.author: Translation
40020792.content: Then, a terrible and hair-raising battle ensued between the sons of Varuna, the lord of waters, and the intelligent Ravana.

40020793.author: पदार्थः
40020793.content: अमात्यैः by ministers, च and, महावीर्यैः very powerful, दशग्रीवस्य of Dashagriva, रक्षसः the Rakshasa, वारुणम् belonging to Varuna, तत् that, बलम् army, कृत्स्नम् entire, क्षणेन in a moment, विनिपातितम् was destroyed,

40020793.author: Translation
40020793.content: And by the very powerful ministers of the Rakshasa Dashagriva, that entire army of Varuna was destroyed in a moment.

40020794.author: पदार्थः
40020794.content: समीक्ष्य having seen, स्वबलम् their own army, सङ्ख्ये in battle, वरुणस्य of Varuna, सुताः sons, तदा then, अर्दिताः afflicted, शरजालेन by a shower of arrows, निवृत्ताः retreated, रणकर्मणः from the act of battle,

40020794.author: Translation
40020794.content: Then, seeing their own army afflicted by a shower of arrows in battle, the sons of Varuna retreated from the fight.

40020795.author: पदार्थः
40020795.content: महीतलगताः situated on the ground, ते they, तु indeed, रावणम् Ravana, दृश्य having seen, पुष्पके in the Pushpaka (chariot), आकाशम् sky, आशु quickly, विविशुः entered, स्यन्दनैः by chariots, शीघ्रगामिभिः swift-moving,

40020795.author: Translation
40020795.content: Indeed, they, who were on the ground, having seen Ravana in the Pushpaka chariot, quickly ascended into the sky with their swift-moving chariots.

40020796.author: पदार्थः
40020796.content: महादासीत् it was great, ततस्तेषां then for them, तुल्यं equal, स्थानमवाप्य having obtained a place, तत् that, आकाशयुद्धं sky-battle, तुमुलं tumultuous, देवदानवयोरिव like that of gods and demons.

40020796.author: Translation
40020796.content: After obtaining an equal position in the sky, a great and tumultuous battle ensued among them, resembling the fierce combat between gods and demons.

40020797.author: पदार्थः
40020797.content: ततस्ते then they, रावणं Ravana, युद्धे in battle, शरैः with arrows, पावकसन्निभैः resembling fire, विमुखीकृत्य having turned away, सन्तुष्टा satisfied, विनेदुर्विविधान्रवान् they roared various sounds.

40020797.author: Translation
40020797.content: Then, having turned Ravana away in battle with their fire-like arrows, they were satisfied and roared various sounds.

40020798.author: पदार्थः
40020798.content: ततो then, महोदरः Mahodara, क्रुद्धो enraged, राजानं the king, दृश्य having seen, धर्षितम् humiliated, त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, मृत्युभयं fear of death, वीरो the hero, युद्धकाङ्क्षी desirous of battle, व्यलोकयत् he looked (at the enemy).

40020798.author: Translation
40020798.content: Then, the enraged hero Mahodara, seeing his king humiliated, abandoned all fear of death and, desirous of battle, looked towards the enemy.

40020799.author: पदार्थः
40020799.content: तेन by him, ते those, दारुणा fierce, युद्धे in battle, कामगाः moving at will, पवनोपमाः resembling wind, महोदरेण by Mahodara, गदया with a mace, हता struck, वै indeed, प्रययुः they went, क्षितिम् to the earth.

40020799.author: Translation
40020799.content: In that fierce battle, those who moved at will and resembled the wind were indeed struck by Mahodara with his mace and fell to the earth.

40020800.author: पदार्थः
40020800.content: तेषां of them, वरुणपुत्राणां of the sons of Varuna, हत्वा having killed, योधान्हयाञ्छतान् hundreds of warriors and horses, मुमोचाशु quickly he let out, महानादं a great roar, विरथान्प्रेक्ष्य having seen them chariot-less, तान्स्थितान् standing.

40020800.author: Translation
40020800.content: Having killed hundreds of warriors and horses belonging to the sons of Varuna, Mahodara quickly let out a great roar upon seeing them standing dismounted from their chariots.

40020801.author: पदार्थः
40020801.content: ते those, तु indeed, तेषां their, रथाः chariots, साश्वाः with horses, सह along with, सारथिभिः charioteers, हतैः killed, महोदरेण by Mahodara, निहताः struck down, पतिताः fell, पृथिवीतले on the ground

40020801.author: Translation
40020801.content: Mahodara struck down their chariots, which, along with their horses and slain charioteers, fell to the ground.

40020802.author: पदार्थः
40020802.content: ते those, तु but, त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, रथान् chariots, पुत्राः sons, वरुणस्य of Varuna, महात्मनः the great-souled, आकाशे in the sky, विष्ठिताः stood, शूराः brave ones, स्वप्रभावात् due to their own power, न not, विव्यथुः were distressed

40020802.author: Translation
40020802.content: But those brave sons of the great-souled Varuna, having abandoned their chariots, stood in the sky and were not distressed due to their inherent power.

40020803.author: पदार्थः
40020803.content: धनूंषि bows, कृत्वा having made, सज्जानि ready, विनिर्भिद्य having pierced, महोदरम् Mahodara, रावणं Ravana, समरे in battle, क्रुद्धाः enraged, सहिताः together, समभिद्रवन् attacked

40020803.author: Translation
40020803.content: Enraged, they made their bows ready, pierced Mahodara, and together attacked Ravana in battle.

40020804.author: पदार्थः
40020804.content: सायकैः with arrows, च and, आपविभ्रष्टैः released from bows, वज्रकल्पैः like thunderbolts, सुदारुणैः very terrible, दारयन्ति स्म they tore apart, सङ्क्रुद्धाः greatly enraged, मेघाः clouds, इव like, महागिरिम् a great mountain

40020804.author: Translation
40020804.content: Greatly enraged, they tore him apart with very terrible arrows, released from their bows and resembling thunderbolts, just as clouds tear apart a great mountain.

40020805.author: पदार्थः
40020805.content: ततः then, क्रुद्धः enraged, दशग्रीवः the ten-necked (Ravana), कालाग्निः the fire of destruction, इव like, निर्गतः emerged, शरवर्षैः with showers of arrows, महाघोरैः very dreadful, तेषां their, मर्मसु vital spots, अताडयत् struck

40020805.author: Translation
40020805.content: Then, the enraged Ravana, appearing like the fire of destruction, struck their vital spots with very dreadful showers of arrows.

40020806.author: पदार्थः
40020806.content: ततः then, तेनैव by him alone, सहसा suddenly, सीदन्ति स्म were sinking, पदातयः the foot-soldiers, मुसलानि maces, विचित्राणि various, ततः then, भल्लशतानि hundreds of spears, च and.

40020806.author: Translation
40020806.content: Then, by him alone, the foot-soldiers suddenly began to collapse under the impact of various maces and hundreds of spears.

40020807.author: पदार्थः
40020807.content: पट्टिशान् sharp-edged spears, च and, एव indeed, शक्तीः lances, च and, शतघ्नीः 'hundred-killers' (a type of weapon), तोमरान् javelins, तथा and also, पातयामास he hurled, दुर्धर्षः the irresistible one (Ravana), तेषाम् upon them, उपरि above, विष्ठितः standing.

40020807.author: Translation
40020807.content: The irresistible Ravana, positioned above them, hurled down sharp-edged spears, lances, 'hundred-killers', and javelins upon them.

40020808.author: पदार्थः
40020808.content: अपविद्धाः struck down, तु but, ते those, वीराः brave ones, विनिष्पेतुः they fled, पदातयः the foot-soldiers, महापङ्कम् a great mud-pit, इव like, आसाद्य having fallen into, कुञ्जराः elephants, षष्टिहायनाः sixty years old.

40020808.author: Translation
40020808.content: Those brave foot-soldiers, struck down, scattered and fled like sixty-year-old elephants that have fallen into a deep mud-pit.

40020809.author: पदार्थः
40020809.content: सीदमानान् sinking, सुतान् sons (enemies), दृष्ट्वा having seen, विह्वलान् distressed, सुमहौजसः very mighty ones, ननाद roared, रावणः Ravana, हर्षात् from joy, महान् a great, अम्बुधरः cloud, यथा like.

40020809.author: Translation
40020809.content: Seeing his very mighty enemies (literally 'sons') collapsing and distressed, Ravana roared with joy like a great thundercloud.

40020810.author: पदार्थः
40020810.content: ततः then, रक्षः the Rakshasa (Ravana), महानादान् great roars, मुक्त्वा having uttered, हन्ति स्म he struck, वारुणान् the followers of Varuna (Devas), नानाप्रहरणोपेतैः with various weapons, धारापातैः with torrents of rain (showers of weapons), इव like, अम्बुदः a cloud.

40020810.author: Translation
40020810.content: Then, the Rakshasa Ravana, having uttered great roars, struck down the followers of Varuna (Devas) with showers of various weapons, just like a cloud pours down torrents of rain.

40020811.author: पदार्थः
40020811.content: ततः then, ते they, विमुखाः turned away (defeated), सर्वे all, पतिताः fallen, धरणीतले on the ground, रणात् from the battle, स्वपुरुषैः by their own men, शीघ्रं quickly, गृहाणि into their homes, एव indeed, प्रवेशिताः were brought.

40020811.author: Translation
40020811.content: Then, all of them, defeated and fallen to the ground, were quickly brought back into their homes by their own men from the battlefield.

40020812.author: पदार्थः
40020812.content: तान् to them, अब्रवीत् said, ततः then, रक्षो the demon (Ravana), वरुणाय to Varuna, निवेद्यताम् let it be announced.

40020812.author: Translation
40020812.content: Then the demon Ravana said to them, "Let this be announced to Varuna."

40020813.author: पदार्थः
40020813.content: रावणं to Ravana, तु indeed, अब्रवीत् said, मन्त्री the minister, प्रहस्तो Prahasta, नाम named, वारुणः of Varuna, गतः gone, खलु indeed, महाराजो the great king, ब्रह्मलोकं to the world of Brahma, जलेश्वरः the lord of waters (Varuna).

40020813.author: Translation
40020813.content: Then a minister of Varuna named Prahasta (or Prahasa) said to Ravana, "Indeed, the great king, the lord of waters Varuna, has gone to the world of Brahma."

40020814.author: पदार्थः
40020814.content: गान्धर्वं Gandharva (music/art), वरुणः Varuna, श्रोतुं to hear, यं whom, त्वं you, आह्वयसे challenge, युधि in battle, तत् therefore, किं what (is the use), तव your, वृथा in vain, वीर O hero, परिश्रम्य having exerted, गते when gone, नृपे the king; ये those who, तु but, सन्निहिताः present, वीराः heroes, कुमाराः princes, ते they, पराजिताः defeated.

40020814.author: Translation
40020814.content: Varuna, whom you challenge in battle, has gone to hear Gandharva music; therefore, O hero, what is the use of your vain exertion when the king is absent, and those princes who were present here have already been defeated?

40020815.author: पदार्थः
40020815.content: राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of demons (Ravana), तु indeed, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, नाम name, विश्राव्य having proclaimed, च and, आत्मनः his own, हर्षात् from joy, नादं a roar, विमुञ्चन् releasing, वै indeed, निष्क्रान्तः departed, वरुणालयात् from Varuna's abode.

40020815.author: Translation
40020815.content: Having heard that, the lord of demons Ravana, proclaiming his own name and uttering a joyful roar, indeed departed from Varuna's abode.

40020816.author: पदार्थः
40020816.content: आगतस्तु having come, पथा by the path, येन by which, तेनैव by that very, विनिवृत्य having returned, सः he, लङ्कामभिमुखो facing Lanka, रक्षो the demon, नभस्तलगतो moving in the sky, ययौ went.

40020816.author: Translation
40020816.content: Having arrived by a certain path, the demon Ravana returned by that very path, flying through the sky towards Lanka. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रयोविंशः सर्गः ।। 23 ।। Thus ends the twenty-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
